diagnostics.message: aws_autoscaling_group.data_nodes depends on aws_autoscaling_group.master_nodes operationally: data nodes must launch only after the master nodes exist so they can join an already-formed Elasticsearch cluster. The graph contains no implicit path (data_nodes' launch config/template and subnet lookups never reference the master ASG) and no depends_on edge, so current ordering does not enforce master-before-data. Add an explicit depends_on on master_nodes (no clean attribute-reference substitute exists).

null_resource.cluster_bootstrap_state writes the bootstrap-state file and is meaningful only once aws_instance.bootstrap_node exists; without an ordering edge it can run before the bootstrap node is created, recording state prematurely so later applies skip re-bootstrapping. The graph has no dependency from the null_resource to the bootstrap instance. Wire it as an implicit dependency via the null_resource's triggers referencing the bootstrap node (count-safe splat) instead of a bare depends_on.
